## Acceptance criteria (all deterministic)
- AC1 FakeEngine integration: created→queued→provisioning→running→waiting_gate→queued→running→finalizing→completed, every transition event-paired in one transaction.
- AC2 Fencing: commit/heartbeat/event from attempt N−1 after re-enqueue → 409 stale_task; task self-terminates.
- AC3 Reaper: killed heartbeat → orphaned → resume attempt N+1 rotated token; third re-enqueue opens resume_partial.
- AC4 Lock matrix: 2nd writer queues w/ running_run_id; review(vN,A)∥review(vN,B) allowed (k=1/k=2); persona run locks persona not project.
- AC5 Duplicate POST /runs one idempotency key → one row.
- AC6 model-profile override whose provider lacks phase-class capabilities rejected at creation (REQ-ARCH-9).
- AC7 State-function table test: every §6.3 row (key, pill, suggested next) reproduced from fixtures, overlays incl.; no status column exists (REQ-PROD-9; REQ-SPEC-3).
- AC8 Completion oracle: phase subtype:'success' but failing predicate → artifact_missing, one guided retry, then failed-with-partials.

## Out of scope
Harvest/delivery internals (P0.09); gate resolution+overlays (P0.10 — we OPEN gates & exit; P0.10 resumes); ledger op internals (P0.11 — we define hold/debit/release signatures + test stub only); estimate service & consent UI (PRB.3); event persistence/partitioning/SSE (P0.08b — we emit via its writer interface); walkthrough/report (P1.5); steering UI; run rounds.

## Architecture decision
New package `@rhema/orchestrator` (packages/orchestrator) = the pure, DI'd run-orchestration core
(matches the chain pattern: engine/hooks/egress-proxy = pure DI core + deferred live shell). Both
apps/api (HTTP routes: run creation + internal run API) and apps/worker (pg-boss consumers:
run.start/resume/cancel/reap + reaper) are thin adapters delegating to it. Live client binding
(pg Pool, pg-boss, Redis, jose/JWT, GKE k8s client, SSE) deferred → DEFERRALS, matching D-P0.07-1.
All 8 ACs are deterministic and proven in-process over PGlite + FakeEngine + fake clock/queue/
heartbeat/launcher/token/ledger.

Deps: @rhema/contracts, @rhema/db, @rhema/engine, @rhema/hooks, @rhema/protocols.

### Modules (packages/orchestrator/src)
- error-class.ts — ErrorClass union + retry policy per §12.4 + ResultSubtype→ErrorClass map.
- state-machine.ts — §12.4 transition graph as data; isTerminal; assertTransition (REQ-RUN-10).
- capabilities.ts — §12.3 phase-class capability table + validateModelProfile (REQ-ARCH-9) [AC6].
- project-state.ts — §6.3 pure state function (REQ-PROD-9/REQ-SPEC-3; ledger K8) [AC7].
- locks.ts — lock-key builders + permitted-overlap matrix + conflicts() (REQ-RUN-17/DATA-39/40) [AC4].
- completion-oracle.ts — three-leg oracle (REQ-SPEC-13) [AC8].
- events.ts — EventWriter interface + InMemoryEventWriter (P0.08b ships SqlEventWriter+store).
- ledger.ts — HoldLedger interface (hold/debit/release/refund) + TestHoldLedger stub (P0.11 real).
- clock.ts / ids.ts / queue.ts / heartbeat.ts / token.ts — DI seams + in-memory impls.
- transition.ts — transactional state+event pairing via TxRunner (REQ-DATA-33) [AC1].
- run-creation.ts — POST/runs: idempotency memo, snapshot freeze, capability validation, hold,
  awaiting_consent gate (REQ-SPEC-16/BILL-6) [AC5,AC6].
- provision.ts — token mint (attempt claim), proxy credential+richer allowlist mint (D-P0.07-3),
  GKE Job launch (JobLauncher, 3 attempts), lock+concurrency admission (REQ-SPEC-11/ARCH-11).
- resolver.ts — createDbRunContextResolver (fills egress-proxy seam; binding deferred).
- internal-api.ts — hydration/heartbeat/postEvents/commitStep/failStep/audit; attempt fencing
  (409 stale_task), token refresh/rotate/revoke (REQ-ARCH-11/RUN-2/15; REQ-DATA-33) [AC1,AC2].
- reaper.ts — stale→orphaned→re-enqueue ≤2→resume_partial (REQ-RUN-14) [AC3].
- phase-loop.ts — drives Engine.startPhase per manifest; usage.tick as sdk_stream provisional;
  oracle; retry classes; back-edge counting (REQ-SPEC-13; REQ-ARCH-32 reaction) [AC1,AC8].
- testing/ — PGlite TxRunner + fakes.

### Migration 0007_run_orchestration.sql (P0.08-owned, additive forward-only)
- run_idempotency(billing_account_id, key, run_id, created_at; unique(billing_account_id,key)) — 24h memo.
- alter projects add active_writer_run_id text — writer-lock conditional update (§12.4).
- alter proxy_allowlists add endpoints jsonb, models text[], url_policy jsonb, cap_credits int — richer allowlist (D-P0.07-3).
- alter proxy_credentials add attempt int default 1, allowlist_id text, credential_hash text, expires_at — resolver join + rotation.
- NOT creating run_events (P0.08b owns the store); EventWriter interface only.

## Gap table (Phase 4) — two independent fresh-context reviews, all findings closed
Design review (HIGH/MED) + gap analysis (deliverable/REQ) → closed:
- [HIGH] writer lock never released → CLOSED: applyTransition clears projects.active_writer_run_id on every
  terminal state (transition.ts) + writer-lock-release test.
- [HIGH] credential never revoked at terminal / not rotated / no expires_at → CLOSED: rotation-revoke before
  mint (provision), terminal revoke in finalizeRun/failRun + reaper/cancel settle, expires_at set at mint
  (credentials.ts) + rotation/expiry + terminal-revoke tests.
- [HIGH] hold not released on cancel → CLOSED: handleRunCancel settles hold+cred on direct-cancel + test.
- [HIGH] cancelling→cancelled unimplemented → CLOSED: completeCancellation + reaper sweep of stale cancelling
  + tests.
- [MED] applyTransition not a CAS → CLOSED: guarded `where state=$from returning id` + ConcurrentTransitionError
  + concurrency test.
- [MED] admission TOCTOU (persona/reader) → CLOSED: pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed by project/persona in admitRun.
- [LOW] aborted misclassified as infra → CLOSED: phase-loop short-circuits `aborted` before the oracle.
- [GAP] back-edge counting missing → CLOSED: reactions.recordReplan (cap 2, REQ-WF-5) + reopenApprovePlan.
- [GAP] REQ-ARCH-32 reaction missing → CLOSED: reactions.pauseRun (refusal card) + handleHookControl.
- [GAP] debit coupling never called → CLOSED: commitStep debits per step (REQ-DATA-34) + test.
- [LOW deferred] stuck-provisioning sweep → D-P0.08-4 (needs system-scoped scan; pg-boss retry covers most).
No out-of-scope creep (P0.09/P0.10/P0.11/P0.08b boundaries clean per gap analysis).
